transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm having a really hard time... I can't seem to remember parts of a really stressful event that happened about three weeks ago. Since then, I've also just felt so disconnected from myself and everything around me, like I'm not really here.
How long has it been since the stressful event happened, and have these symptoms lasted for more than one month?
The stressful event happened exactly three weeks ago. I have been experiencing these symptoms ever since it happened, so it has been about three weeks now, which is less than a month.
Since the event, have you been having unwanted memories, nightmares, or flashbacks about what happened?
No, I haven't really been having nightmares or vivid flashbacks of the event. It's actually the opposite—I have a lot of trouble remembering what happened, with large gaps in my memory.
Since the event, have you been avoiding reminders of it, like certain places, people, conversations, or thoughts about what happened?
I haven't really noticed myself avoiding reminders or anything like that. To be honest, I'm not really sure if I've been doing that at all.
Since the event, have you been feeling especially on edge, easily startled, irritable, or having trouble sleeping or concentrating?

No, I haven't really been feeling on edge, irritable, or having trouble sleeping. It's more that I feel completely detached from my own body and everything around me, like a ghost. I'm just really struggling with those huge gaps in my memory.
Have these symptoms been making it hard for you to work, take care of things at home, or be around other people?
To be honest, I'm not really sure. I haven't really thought about how it's affecting my work or home life yet. I've just been so focused on trying to understand this weird feeling of disconnection.
Did this stressful event involve actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence, either to you directly or by witnessing it happen to someone else?
I'm really not sure, to be honest. Because of the gaps in my memory, I find it very hard to recall the exact details of what actually happened.
Besides feeling disconnected, have things around you ever seemed unreal or dreamlike, or have you felt as if you were watching yourself from outside your body?

Yes, exactly, it's been so frightening. I often feel like I'm floating above my own body, watching myself go through the motions from the outside. At the same time, my surroundings sometimes feel completely fake and dreamlike, as if I'm living in a movie.
Even if the details are blurry, do you remember whether you believed at the time that you or someone else might die or be seriously hurt?
I'm really not sure, to be honest. I can't remember clearly because everything from that moment is just so blurry and fragmented in my mind.
What do you remember about the event itself, even if it’s only a few pieces—was it something like an accident, assault, or another situation where someone could have been badly hurt?

I honestly can't tell you because almost the entire event is a complete blank to me. I only remember tiny, scattered fragments that don't make any sense together, making it impossible to describe what actually happened. The vast majority of the situation is just completely gone from my mind.
